rows.citation: tapefs §9.5 writes only the destination and engine-api §7.2 excludes destination failure from FAULTED, so a tape_dup continuation never issues a write or flush against its own (source) device. Not a contract conflict: the WP-12a clause is conditional on such a failure. Complement accepted: R29-B already-FAULTED source (LONG-10).

R29-A reaches its Faulted row through a tape_arm write-failure fixture; R29-C's faulted_row observation carries no causal link to its own-device failures. No package probes the row on the instance the failing continuation quarantined, nor the pass-1 header-flush path specifically.
